scope: Local review only. No Shopify page or checkout-policy writes.
reviewRequired: Exact public legal business name, physical business address, phone, and relationship to Casify
Confirm that delivery estimates start from shipment rather than order date
Confirm existing 30-day return policy commitments, including prepaid labels, refund after first carrier scan and 5-10 business day refund time
Provide the actual return destination address
Add approved refund, shipping, terms and contact-information text to Shopify checkout Policies only after approval
Privacy source retains current Moroccan contact details until approved replacement is provided

termsChange.from: Payment is processed securely through Shopify Payments and other supported payment providers at checkout.
termsChange.to: Payments are processed using the payment methods displayed at checkout.

customerProof: Unverified sales count and customer-video sections disabled on the default page template.
